updated_status: structure-derived contact regions identified, but not final JSON-ready
what_was_missing: Exact RYR2 residues/fragments that form the FKBP1B interface. FKBP1B does not bind one simple continuous RYR2 peptide.
new_evidence: Downloaded and parsed RCSB 7U9T mmCIF. RYR2 chains B/G/H/I contact FKBP1B chains A/C/D/E. RYR2 residues within 5A cluster around SPRY1-like residues 633-750 plus additional regions around 1309-1313 and 1631-1781.
candidate_residue_design: Option A: structure-derived multi-fragment/domain-context job containing RYR2 599-809, 1300-1320, 1620-1790 + FKBP1B. Option B: defer AF3 and use 7U9T-derived interface features directly.
why_not_json_ready_yet: AlphaFold Server may not handle artificial disconnected RYR2 fragments as one native chain. We need to decide whether to submit separate RYR2 fragments as separate entities, a larger continuous 599-1790 fragment, or use PDB-derived features only.
next_action: Review 7U9T contact table and choose one of: large continuous RYR2 599-1790 + FKBP1B; separate RYR2 domain fragments + FKBP1B; or no AF3, use PDB contact mapping.

what_was_missing: Which RYR2 luminal sequence should be modeled with CASQ2/TRDN.
new_evidence: Literature reports direct CSQ2 interaction with RyR2 first luminal loop and describes an RyR2-LL1 fragment at residues 4521-4573. TRDN KEKE motif around residues 200-224 is reported as a CASQ2-interaction motif.
candidate_residue_design: RYR2 LL1 4521-4573 + CASQ2, and separately CASQ2 + TRDN luminal/KEKE region. A 3-chain RYR2 LL1 + CASQ2 + TRDN job can be considered after the pair jobs.
why_not_json_ready_yet: RYR2 LL1 is a short luminal loop and may be poorly structured alone. CASQ2 is oligomeric/calcium-dependent, and TRDN has membrane/luminal topology. Need decide full-length vs luminal fragment and whether to include calcium.
next_action: Create cautious draft JSON candidates for RYR2_LL1-CASQ2 and CASQ2-TRDN first; keep 3-way complex as secondary.
